limitations: Diagnostic samples, not stable tail, capacity, long-duration soak or production promotion.
Loopback HTTP, full canonical responses and exact retries included; browser/rendering excluded.
PostgreSQL RSS sums all descendant working sets; shared pages may be double-counted. CPU includes sampled live/exited processes but sub-second children can be missed.
Background admission is bounded; actual running overlap is recorded rather than assuming uninterrupted CPU load.
Orchestration Python is test tooling; no Python domain/command worker is started.
Running status brackets the protection/retry/GET sequence; it does not prove overlap of every individual request.
The 330s HTTP admission budget is not a hard wall deadline; database work and cleanup can exceed it.
Quiet/loaded financial equality uses the same implementation; research artifacts are checked for identity/hash/count, not full independent metric parity.
